title: English Practice Quiz 0791
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: He speaks English ___.
questions.explanation: Clearly is the adverb describing how he speaks.

questions.question: They ___ ready for the meeting.
questions.explanation: Use are with the plural subject they.

questions.question: Listen! The baby ___.
questions.explanation: Listen! suggests an action happening now, so use the present continuous.

questions.question: By next June, he ___ the course.
questions.explanation: The future perfect describes an action completed before a future time.

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'available'?
options: ready or able to be used
questions.explanation: Available means ready for use or accessible.

questions.question: We have a meeting ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: Use on with days and dates.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use do + subject + base verb for present simple questions with you.

questions.question: Which word has a different beginning sound?
questions.explanation: This begins with the voiced /ð/ sound; the others begin with the unvoiced /θ/ sound.

questions.question: Read: 'Please keep the floor dry to prevent accidents.' What is the instruction?
questions.explanation: The notice instructs people to keep the floor dry.

questions.question: Which question asks for a reason?
